[ASSISTANT] Recommended handling cameras with clean, dry hands or gloves to prevent oil damage.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested using a soft, dry brush or blower bulb to remove dust from cameras.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended cleaning lenses with a soft, microfiber cloth and a gentle cleaning solution.  
[ASSISTANT] Advised lubricating moving parts with light machine oil or silicone lubricant.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested checking and replacing seals to prevent light leaks.
